command:
printf 'ROOT_AUTH
'; id -u
printf '
DOCKER_CONTAINERS
'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Image}}'
printf '
CONTAINERD_TASKS
'; ctr --namespace moby tasks list
printf '
SNAP_SERVICES
'; snap services
printf '
NETWORK_FILESYSTEMS
'; findmnt -rn -t nfs,nfs4,cifs
printf '
BLUETOOTH_ADAPTERS
'; ls -d /sys/class/bluetooth/hci* 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
SERVICE_CONFIG
'; systemctl cat nvweston.service nvmemwarning.service automagic-fan.service gpsd.socket; cat /etc/modules-load.d/cups-filters.conf; cat /etc/modules-load.d/nv.conf
printf '
APT_CANDIDATES
'; apt-cache policy libssl-dev libudev-dev libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-0 libclang-dev shellcheck
printf '
APT_SIMULATION
'; apt-get -s --no-install-recommends install libssl-dev libudev-dev libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-dev libclang-dev shellcheck
printf '
MODULE_INSPECTION
'; for m in bnep lp ppdev parport_pc; do modinfo -F filename "$m" 2>/dev/null || true; done
printf '
APT_RUNNING
'; ps -C apt -C apt-get -C dpkg -o pid,etimes,args

[Unit]
Description=Display Low memory warning
; Everything depends on the NVIDIA per-boot script
After=nv.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/etc/systemd/nvmemwarning.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /lib/systemd/system/automagic-fan.service
[Unit]
Description=Automagic fan control

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /usr/local/bin/automagic-fan/fanctl.py
ExecStopPost=/bin/sh -c '/bin/echo 0 > /sys/devices/pwm-fan/target_pwm'
User=root
StandardOutput=journal+console
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /lib/systemd/system/gpsd.socket
[Unit]
Description=GPS (Global Positioning System) Daemon Sockets

[Socket]
ListenStream=/var/run/gpsd.sock
ListenStream=[::1]:2947
ListenStream=127.0.0.1:2947
# To allow gpsd remote access, start gpsd with the -G option and
# uncomment the next two lines:
# ListenStream=[::1]:2947
# ListenStream=0.0.0.0:2947
SocketMode=0600

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target
